title: Text Formatting
description: Text formatting allows developers to emphasize or modify the appearance of text within a webpage.
HTML provides several tags such as <b> for bold text, <i> for italic text, <u> for underlined text, <strong> for important text, and <em> for emphasized text.
These formatting options help highlight important information, improve content presentation, and make webpages more visually appealing and easier to read.
